query: INSERT INTO latest_garage_door_state (device_id, state, contact) VALUES ($1, $2, $3) ON CONFLICT (device_id) DO UPDATE SET changed_at = CASE WHEN latest_garage_door_state.state = EXCLUDED.state THEN latest_garage_door_state.changed_at ELSE now() END, state = EXCLUDED.state, contact = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.contact, latest_garage_door_state.contact), updated_at = now()
